issues.issue: Whether the claimant's account of living with his wife and the secret marriage is credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he lived with his wife in Tolima and the marriage was secret, which explains the gaps.
issues.result_text: Negative inferences drawn from inconsistent living arrangements and the undocumented secret marriage.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant has a subjective fear of FARC given his returns to Colombia and loss of US status
issues.result_text: Claimant did not have a very strong fear of FARC; his re-availments show lack of subjective fear.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant would face a serious risk or need protection on return
issues.result_text: Due to lack of credibility, claimant is not in need of protection.
